row.notes: SignalR connection start/handshake reply. Mode byte this+0x10738: 1 = classic (key Response compared to the expected value), 2 = core handshake (expects {}, logs Unexpected SignalR handshake); on success sets state byte this+0x228 = 6 and notifies listeners this+0x10720..0x10728 (vcall +0x10 with eWebSocketStarted, +8 with connection id this+0x106f0); also reads ConnectionToken/ConnectionId/Url. Addon: know when the NEOS realtime socket is up.
